description:
About our brand and products:
Sposie creates safe, parent-approved solutions like Booster Pads (Diaper Doublers) for overnight leak protection and Cross Trainers, the first insertable pad that lets kids stay in underwear while potty training. All products are dermatologist-tested, hypoallergenic, and made in the USA.

What makes us different:

  • Unique, first-of-its-kind products

  • Trusted by 20,000+ parents and thousands of five-star reviews

  • Free from harmful chemicals

  • Proven results: leak protection, rash prevention, better sleep

How affiliates can earn:

  • 10% commission on all sales

  • 15% + $100 bonus at $2,000 sales

  • 20% + $300 bonus at $5,000 sales

  • 15% audience discount code provided

How to promote us:

  • Share authentic reviews on TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, blogs

  • Create product demos or parenting tips content

  • Add links to blogs, Amazon store recommendations, or gift guides

Other information:

  • Available on Amazon, TikTok Shop, and our in-house program

  • Affiliate support with samples, creative assets, and open communication

Commission Review, Approval, and Payout Terms

All commissions earned through the Sposie Affiliate Program are subject to review, validation, and approval by Sposie in its sole discretion.

Pending Period

Commissions are initially recorded as pending upon placement of a referred order. A minimum 30-day holding period from the order date is required before any commission becomes eligible for review. This period allows for order fulfillment verification, returns, cancellations, chargebacks, or payment disputes.

Commission Approval

Commissions are reviewed and approved on a monthly basis. Only commissions associated with orders that are successfully completed, fully paid, and not refunded, canceled, disputed, or otherwise invalidated will be approved. Sposie reserves the right to approve, adjust, or deny commissions at its sole discretion where program terms are not met.

Payout Schedule

Approved commissions are paid on or about the 5th day of each calendar month for commissions approved during the prior period. Payment timing may vary due to payment processor delays, holidays, or technical issues.

Minimum Payout Threshold

A minimum approved commission balance of $50 USD is required in order to receive a payout. Approved commissions that do not meet this threshold will automatically carry forward to subsequent payout periods until the minimum payout threshold is met.

Administration and Rights

Commission tracking, approval, and payouts are administered through Sposie’s affiliate platform. Sposie reserves the right to withhold, reverse, or recover commissions resulting from refunded transactions, canceled orders, fraudulent activity, abuse of the affiliate program, or violations of these Terms & Conditions.
